headlines.text: Back on this day in 2021, a new chapter began as The Good Brothers vs. Dark Order (Grayson & Uno) fought for the brand-new Impact World Tag Team Titles, appearing on Dynamite, rated 5.52. A first for AEW/Impact crossover ? this was the first time the Impact World Tag Team Titles were ever defended on Dynamite, and Uno and Grayson's chemistry nearly pulled off a shock upset before the Good Brothers survived with the Magic Killer.
Looking back to 2023, when Saraya made their return to AEW television after just over 2 months away, appearing on Rampage.
Looking back to 2021, when AEW welcomed The Sydal Brothers for the first time as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.82 ? a match that delivered.

secondaries.text: On this day in 2023, the AEW International Title was up for grabs as Darby Allin vs. Brian Cage went to war, appearing on Rampage, rated 6.68.
2021 brought us this moment: Wheeler Yuta stepped through the curtain for the first time, appearing on Dynamite, rated 4.96.
Flash back to 2021, when Chris Jericho vs. Wardlow met in a Qualifying Match, topping the bill that night on Dynamite, rated 3.96.
